theater: 大別山北麓、淮水上游義陽

battle.name: 鍾離、義陽之戰
battle.theater: 大別山北麓、淮水上游義陽
battle.brief: 天監元年冬至二年春（502–503），北魏大軍合圍大別山北麓的義陽，梁征虜將軍曹景宗率禁軍與州郡兵往援，兩軍在淮水上游相持，義陽終歸北魏掌握，鍾離、壽陽一線隨後成為梁魏爭鋒的主戰場。卡面這把亞述長弓代表的複合反曲弓雖未入中國戰場，卻是魏軍騎兵角弓與梁軍蹶張弩同一譜系的前身。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 義陽、鍾離之戰是南朝梁與北魏在淮水上游、大別山北麓一線的第一次正面較量。交戰一方是建康的梁，梁武帝蕭衍於天監元年三月即位後以《天監》紀年，朝廷的野戰主力仍由禁軍與各州郡兵構成；另一方是洛陽的北魏，孝文帝拓跋宏推行漢化、遷都洛陽並整飭兵制之後，世宗宣武帝拓跋珪在位，淮南王拓跋英以尚書令、都督淮壽諸軍的身份統兵節制淮上。義陽解圍之役，梁方由征虜將軍曹景宗率羽林、虎旅等中兵與徐、司二州的沿邊郡兵北上，兵種以步兵、弩手、射手為主，並攜帶工匠隨軍造器械、築壘、修橋；淮南方面則由豫州刺史蕭宏鎮守壽陽，韋叡、曹景宗、昌義之分守壽陽、鍾離、合肥三個支點，後方糧秣靠淮水、汝水與穎水的船運轉送。魏軍的兵源兼有拓跋部、鮮卑、漢人、高車、羯、氐等，調兵以行軍為主，淮上作戰以騎兵與步兵混編，攻城倚靠鎮兵與隨軍工匠，南征序列裡常雜有高車騎兵。魏方後續的戰線由宗室元英接手，先後攻壽陽、懸壄、襄陽，把這條邊界線又往南推了一段。
countriesEn: The Yiyang-Zhongli campaign was the first direct major clash between the Liang of the south and the Northern Wei on the upper Huai River and at the northern foot of the Dabie Mountains. On one side stood the Liang of Jiankang: Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, had taken the throne in the third month of the first year of Tianjian and dated his reign thereafter by the Tianjian era, and the field armies of the state were still built out of the capital guards together with the troops of the individual provinces and commanderies. On the other stood the Northern Wei of Luoyang, which after the sinicisation of Emperor Xiaowen Tuoba Hong, the move of the capital to Luoyang and the reform of the military system was ruled by Emperor Xuanwu Tuoba Gui, with the Prince of Huainan, Tuoba Ying, holding the command of the armies on the Huai and at Shou in his capacity as Director of the Secretariat. In the relief of Yiyang the Liang side marched north under General of the Conqueror of the Barbarians Cao Jingzong, with the elite Feather Forest and Tiger Host of the central army and the frontier troops of Xuzhou and Sizhou; the fighting strength consisted of infantry, crossbowmen and archers, with engineers attached to build siege machines, raise ramparts and throw bridges. On the Huai front the Inspectorate Commissioner of Yu Province, Xiao Hong, held Shouyang, while Wei Rui, Cao Jingzong and Chang Yizhi between them watched the three pivots of Shouyang, Zhongli and Hefei, and the grain for the rear came by boat along the Huai, the Ru and the Ying. The northern army drew its men from Tuooba, Xianbei, Han, Gaoche, Jie and Di elements, troops were raised as campaigning columns, combat on the Huai combined cavalry with infantry, and sieges leaned on the garrison troops and on attached engineers, with bodies of Gaoche cavalry regularly riding within the southern expedition columns. The northern line was later taken over by the clan prince Yuan Ying, who struck at Shouyang, Xuancheng and Xiangyang in turn and pushed this frontier a further stage south.
people: 梁武帝蕭衍是天監元年三月在建康受禪即位、隨即掀起北伐的決策者，他志在恢復南朝失去的淮北與漢中，把義陽、鍾離一線視為必取之地。曹景宗出身寒微，自蕭衍起兵便隨軍效命，義陽被圍時他率援軍北上解圍，四年後又在鍾離與韋叡同任主將，軍後封河東縣公，遷侍中與中衛將軍。韋叡是京兆杜陵人，壽陽防務與鍾離渡淮的策劃者，他以少量兵眾在淮上架成浮橋，時人號為韋虎，後官至豫州刺史。蕭宏是武帝之弟，出鎮豫州、治壽陽，負責壘城與堰水。昌義之是鍾離守將，以數千守兵抵擋魏軍的攻城器械百餘日而城不陷。柳憐在《梁書》中有專傳，參與鍾離攻勢，據傳最終陣歿。魏方主事者為世宗宣武帝拓跋珪與淮南王拓跋英，楊大眼是南安王，原出仇池楊氏，降魏後以驍勇著稱，擔任淮上主攻；宗室元英在後續戰事中接手淮西兵權，魏軍序列裡還有高車等部落的騎兵部隊協同作戰。
peopleEn: Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, is the ruler who took the throne at Jiankang in the third month of the first year of Tianjian and immediately launched the northern campaigns, determined to recover the northern Huai and Hanzhong lost by the southern dynasties and treating the Yiyang-Zhongli line as ground that had to be taken. Cao Jingzong, a man of humble origin who had followed Xiao Yan since the rising, led the relief column north when Yiyang was invested and four years later shared the command at Zhongli with Wei Rui; after the victory he was ennobled as Count of Hedong and advanced to Gentleman of the Household and Commander of the Central Guard. Wei Rui, a native of Duling in the capital district, planned the defence of Shouyang and the crossing of the Huai at Zhongli, raising a floating bridge over the river with a handful of men, earning the nickname of Wei the Tiger, and he ended as Inspectorate Commissioner of Yu Province. Xiao Hong, the emperor's younger brother, was posted to Yu Province at Shouyang and was responsible for the ramparts and the dam. Chang Yizhi was the commandant of Zhongli, holding the city with a few thousand men against the northern siege machines for more than a hundred days without falling. Liu Lian, who has a dedicated biography in the Book of Liang, took part in the assault on Zhongli and is said to have died in the final fighting. On the northern side the powers were Emperor Xuanwu Tuobao Gui and the Prince of Huainan, Tuoba Ying, while Yang Daoyan, Prince of Nan'an, a scion of the Yang clan of Chouchi who had surrendered to Wei and was famed for his ferocity, led the northern assault; the clan prince Yuan Ying inherited the western Huai command in the operations that followed, and bodies of Gaoche cavalry fought in the northern ranks.
kits: 卡面這把亞述長弓是前七世紀亞述王國的角木筋複合反曲弓，弓身短、張力大、箭道平直，亞述弓兵習慣把弓拉近面頰、以高拉法放矢，並常站在車上射擊，由車兵替他們開路。它並沒有出現在義陽與鍾離的戰場上，但它代表的是同一條技術譜系的中段形態：弓臂以角、木、筋層層複合，張力遠勝木弓，能配穿甲的箭鑿，這正是草原騎兵自漢末魏晉以來倚仗的角弓。中國方面的投射主力則是弩，梁軍有蹶張弩、抱腰弩與擘張弩，張力大、上弦慢，適合守城與對付攻城器械，鍾離城頭反擊木驢與撞車的正是這類弩手；魏軍則以角弓配騎兵，攻城序列中以大盾、槊、騎槊與雲梯、木驢、撞車並行。亞述那套弓兵立於車上、車兵替弓兵開路的辦法，在六世紀的中國換了形式延續：魏軍的弓手跟在攻城器械與大盾之後逐步推進，梁軍則把弓弩手配置在牆堞與壘頂，車與船成為渡河與運糧的工具。雙方也都備有載運輜重與傷兵的車船，糧秣依賴淮水船隊；若把亞述弓放進這場戰爭，它的位置就在魏軍騎兵弓手與梁軍弩手之間那條界線上，是任何一支軍隊都無法省略的遠程火力底盤。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card face is the horn-wood-sinew composite recurve of the seventh-century Assyrian kingdom: short-bodied, high in tension and flat in trajectory. Assyrian archers drew the bow close to the cheek and released in the high-draw style, and they habitually shot from the platform of a chariot while the chariotry opened the way for them. No such bow stood on the field at Yiyang or Zhongli, yet it represents the middle of a single technical lineage: the laminated horn, wood and sinew limb carried far more tension than a plain wooden bow and could therefore be paired with bodkin arrows able to pierce armour, which is exactly the composite bow the steppe cavalry had relied on since the late Han and through the Wei and Jin. On the Chinese side the principal missile force was the crossbow. Liang fielded the shoulder-struck, waist-held and drawn crossbows, weapons of great tension but slow to reload, suited to the defence of walls and to countering siege machines, and it was crossbowmen of that kind on the wall of Zhongli who answered the wooden mules and the battering rams. Wei matched its composite bows with cavalry, its assault columns moving forward alongside large shields, spears, cavalry lances, scaling ladders, wooden mules and rams. The Assyrian practice of archers standing on carts while the charioteers opened the road for them continued in sixth-century China in another form: the northern archers advanced step by step behind the siege machines and the large shields, while the Liang posted their bowmen and crossbowmen on the parapets and the ramparts, with wagons and boats serving to cross rivers and move grain. Both sides also had wagons and boats to carry supplies and the wounded, and the commissariat travelled on the Huai. Placed in this war, the Assyrian bow would stand on the line between the northern mounted archers and the Liang crossbowmen, the long-range base that no army can do without.
tactics: 義陽攻防是典型的圍城與打援：魏軍以重兵合圍，築長圍困住城池，同時分兵斷絕梁方援軍的糧道，再以器械逼近牆根；梁方先以守軍固守待援，援軍曹景宗部在行軍途中先設營自固，逼近敵營再與守軍合勢，迫使魏軍暫時解圍。鍾離之戰的攻城與反攻城更為細密：魏軍造木驢、撞車逼近城牆，挖掘地道企圖潛入；守將昌義之沿城壁築起長堞與之對射，用長竿刺穿木驢的鼻部，再以油料灌入縱火，另掘塹塞住魏軍挖出的地道，屢次挫敗器械進攻。韋叡的解法不在正面強攻，他命人乘夜在淮水中流架設浮橋，一夜而成，工兵在弩手與弓手的掩護下把橋面向北推過水面，主力隨即渡河；蕭宏則在壽陽修築雙重城壘，藉土石築壩抬高淮水，讓上游來水灌入魏軍營地，迫其退兵。行軍上，梁軍由建康沿淮水與汝、穎水水道北上，靠船隊輸送糧秣；魏軍騎兵多取大別山與淮北的南北通道迂迴包抄，並以游騎斷梁軍的糧道。
tacticsEn: The struggle for Yiyang was a classic combination of siege and relief. The northern army closed in with heavy forces, built an extended line of circumvallation to hold the city in, split off detachments to cut the grain road of the Liang relieving column, and only then brought engines up against the foot of the wall. The Liang side relied on the garrison to hold out until relief came, and the relieving column under Cao Jingzong first fortified its own camp on the march, closed on the enemy camp and only then linked up with the besieged, which forced the northern army to lift the investment for a time. The fighting at Zhongli was finer-grained still, alternating between siege and countersiege. The northern army built wooden mules and battering rams to come up against the wall and dug tunnels in an attempt to enter unseen. The commandant Chang Yizhi answered by raising long parapets along the rampart and shooting at them, piercing the noses of the mules with long poles, pouring oil into them and setting them alight, and by digging a trench to plug the tunnels the northern sappers had driven, breaking up the machine assault again and again. Wei Rui's solution lay not in a frontal assault: he had a floating bridge thrown across the Huai in the night over the midstream shallows, finished in a single night, with engineers pushing the span out over the water under the covering fire of crossbowmen and archers and the main body crossing behind it. Xiao Hong, meanwhile, built a double rampart at Shouyang and used earth and stone to dam the Huai, raising the water so that the incoming current flooded the northern camp and forced it to withdraw. In movement terms the Liang marched north from Jiankang along the Huai and the Ru and Ying waterways, ferrying grain by boat, while the northern cavalry worked round the north-south routes over the Dabie Mountains and the northern bank of the Huai, sending out light horse to cut the Liang supply line.
data: 可核對的數字不多，而且多帶史家概數的性質。年代：義陽被圍始於天監元年（502）冬，延續到天監二年（503）春；鍾離的圍城自天監五年（506）冬起，到天監六年（507）春解圍，前後約百日；第一次梁魏戰爭則以梁天監元年即位至天監七年罷兵為主線，跨五〇〇至五〇七年。兵力：鍾離守軍為昌義之部的數千人，援軍到達之後，梁軍在戰場上的總數達數萬；魏軍投入淮上的兵力，《梁書》與《魏書》常作「數十萬」的概數，實際當然遠少於此，即使在「十餘萬」的說法裡這也是最保守的取法。損失：魏軍在淮水合圍中溺死與被斬者，記為數萬，浮屍蔽水十餘里；梁軍方面的確切斬獲數字多不見於史冊正文，只在奏捷與追述中以概數出現。器械：浮橋一夜而成，長約數十丈；魏軍攻城所用木驢、撞車的數量不見於記載，可確定的是同一時間至少有一次集中進攻。長度：義陽至壽陽約四百里，至鍾離近六百里，舊制一里約合今五百米，水路更為迂迴。守城器械一項，《梁書·昌義之傳》記昌義之屢破魏軍進攻器械，是判斷當時攻城技術水準的硬證。
dataEn: Few of the figures available can be checked, and most of them are of the order of magnitude that historians use. Dates: the investment of Yiyang began in the winter of the first year of Tianjian (502) and ran on into the spring of the second year (503); the siege of Zhongli began in the winter of the fifth year of Tianjian (506) and was relieved in the spring of the sixth (507), a matter of roughly a hundred days; the first Liang-Wei war as a whole runs from the accession in the first year of Tianjian to the armistice in the seventh, that is from 500 to 507. Strength: the garrison of Zhongli was the few thousand men of Chang Yizhi's command, and once the reliefs arrived the Liang fielded a total of several tens of thousands on the ground. The northern force committed to the Huai is given in the Book of Liang and the Book of Wei as a round figure of several tens of thousands, far more than any real number, and it is the most conservative of the estimates that reach into the hundred-thousands. Losses: those of the northern army drowned in the Huai or cut down are put at several tens of thousands, with floating corpses covering more than a dozen li of the water; the exact tally of the Liang on the attacking side is seldom given in the main texts and survives only in memorial reports and retrospectives in the form of general expressions. Engines: the floating bridge was finished in a single night and measured several dozen li in length; the numbers of wooden mules and battering rams used by the northern side are not recorded, though at least one concentrated assault is certain. Distances: from Yiyang to Shouyang is about four hundred li and to Zhongli close to six hundred li, an old li being roughly five hundred modern metres, and the water route is longer again. On the siege equipment, the biography of Chang Yizhi in the Book of Liang records his repeated destruction of the northern assault machines, and that is the hardest piece of evidence for the level of siegecraft of the age.
cause: 義陽之所以成為導火線，在地理上是因為它扼住大別山南北通道與淮水上游的門戶：義陽在北魏手中，梁方的江淮與荊北就暴露在魏軍的進攻鋒面；義陽在梁方手中，壽陽與合肥才有屏障。政治上，梁武帝即位不滿一年便大舉北伐，是要藉軍事勝利證明新朝的正統與內部穩定，趁齊末戰亂留下的邊防空虛取回淮北；北魏則剛經孝文帝的漢化與六鎮整飭，國力回升，正欲趁梁朝新立、主力尚在長江之南時把邊界推回淮水，並鞏固洛陽對南方的門戶。直接導火線是天監元年冬北魏大軍進攻義陽、隨後再度合圍。義陽攻防牽動全局，兩軍在淮上反覆爭鋒；蕭衍與蕭宏先後增兵壽陽、鍾離，戰役於是由一次邊境攻防擴成第一次梁魏戰爭的主戰場，而四年後的鍾離之戰又把整條戰線的走向定了下來。
causeEn: Yiyang became the fuse above all for geographical reasons, because it held the north-south passes of the Dabie Mountains and the gateway of the upper Huai. In the hands of the Northern Wei the approaches of Jianghuai and Jingbei lay open to the northern army; only in the hands of the Liang did Shouyang and Hefei have a screen. Politically, Emperor Wu of Liang launched his northern campaigns less than a year after his accession, in order to demonstrate the legitimacy and the internal solidity of the new dynasty and to take back the northern Huai while the frontier was still hollow after the disorders of the late Qi. The Northern Wei, having just gone through the sinicisation of Emperor Xiaowen and the reorganisation of the six garrisons, saw its strength recovering and wanted to push the frontier back to the Huai while the new southern court was still absorbed in the south of the Yangtze, consolidating the gate of Luoyang against the south. The immediate trigger was the great northern army that attacked Yiyang in the winter of the first year of Tianjian and then invested it again. Because the contest at Yiyang pulled in the whole front, the two armies fought for it repeatedly along the Huai. Xiao Yan and Xiao Hong reinforced Shouyang and Zhongli in turn, and the engagement grew from a border action into the main theatre of the first Liang-Wei war, while the battle of Zhongli four years later settled the direction of the entire line.
impact: 鍾離一役的結果改變了淮北的力量對比。魏軍在淮上損失以萬計的兵力與大量攻城器械，淮南王拓跋英退回淮北，北魏在一段時間內無力再攻江淮，梁軍得以在壽陽築壘、與魏軍隔淮相持。梁朝隨之把重心北移，韋叡、曹景宗、昌義之這批江淮將領一時並舉，壽陽、鍾離、合肥沿線的營壘與屯田漸漸成形。但這只是長線相持的一端：義陽、壽陽仍在魏手，蕭宏守壽陽的體系在隨後的戰役中被元英擊破，江淮防線又回到原來的位置，北魏反而以鍾離受挫為由加速整合淮北的鎮兵與戶口。對南方而言，這場戰爭留下的最大影響是：南北力量在淮水一線形成長期對峙，北方以六鎮的軍制承包下了來日崩潰的伏筆，南方則在隋前夜第一次領略到江淮防務對政權存亡的份量。兵器層面上，弩兵、角弓騎射與攻城器械的對抗，確立了南北朝以來以城池攻防為主的戰爭樣態。
impactEn: The outcome at Zhongli changed the balance of power in the northern Huai. The northern army lost a force of several thousand men and much of its siege equipment when the river rose against it; the Prince of Huainan, Tuoba Ying, fell back across the Huai; and for a time Wei could not afford to attack Jianghuai again, while the Liang were able to raise ramparts at Shouyang and stand face to face with the north across the water. The southern court accordingly shifted its weight northward, a generation of frontier commanders such as Wei Rui, Cao Jingzong and Chang Yizhi rose together, and the entrenched line with its garrisons and garrison farms along Shouyang, Zhongli and Hefei gradually took shape. Yet this was only one end of a long contest. Yiyang and Shouyang remained in northern hands, Xiao Hong's system at Shouyang was broken by Yuan Ying in the operations that followed, the Jianghuai defence line fell back to where it had been, and the north, stung at Zhongli, pressed on all the more with the integration of the garrison troops and the households of the northern Huai. For the south the greatest legacy of this war was that a long confrontation took root along the Huai between north and south: on the northern side the six garrisons were already carrying the seeds of a later collapse under the military system they had been given, while the southern court had a first taste, a generation before the Sui, of how decisive the Jianghuai defence was to the life of a regime. At the level of arms, the duel between crossbow infantry, mounted composite-bow archers and siege machinery fixed the shape of the siege-centred warfare that ran through the Six Dynasties and the Northern and Southern Dynasties.
result: 就義陽本身而言，天監元年冬至二年春（502–503）的攻守以魏軍佔優收場：北魏不但逐退了曹景宗的援軍，最終也把義陽城與郡治掌握在自己手中，使大別山通道重新成為北方的進攻線，義陽郡的軍政與戶口也被納入北魏的邊鎮體系。梁軍沒有在義陽遭到殲滅，但同樣守不住這道門戶，雙方把爭奪重心轉向淮水下游的壽陽與鍾離。四年後的鍾離之戰，梁軍以韋叡的浮橋與蕭宏的堰壩水攻取得大勝，魏軍主力退回淮北，梁軍進至壽陽、修壘與魏軍相持，義陽至鍾離這條線就這樣被拉成長期邊界的一條線。第一場梁魏戰爭以梁方在下游得手、魏方在上游固守的格局收場，雙方都沒有達成消滅對方的目標，戰爭轉為長期的邊境消耗與屯田對峙，直到侯景之亂把南朝內部撕開，北魏才趁勢取走江淮。
resultEn: As far as Yiyang itself was concerned, the attack and defence of the winter of 502 and the spring of 503 ended with the advantage on the Wei side. The northern army not only drove off Cao Jingzong's relieving force but in the end took the city of Yiyang and its commandery seat into its own hands, so that the pass of the Dabie Mountains became once more a northern line of advance, and the military administration and the households of Yiyang commandery were drawn into the northern frontier system. The Liang army was not annihilated at Yiyang, but neither did it hold the gate, and both sides moved the centre of the contest downriver to Shouyang and Zhongli. Four years later the battle of Zhongli was won in full by the Liang, Wei Rui's floating bridge and Xiao Hong's dam sending the river over the northern camp; the northern main body withdrew across the Huai, the Liang advanced to Shouyang, raised ramparts and stood facing Wei, and the line from Yiyang to Zhongli was thus drawn out into one of the long borders of the age. The first Liang-Wei war closed with the south holding the lower river and the north holding the upper, neither side achieving the destruction of the other; the war became a long contest of border attrition and garrison farming, until the rebellion of Hou Jing tore the southern court open and the north took the river lands.
